_comment: Local timed run of h3.py on the raw sample v0 (Cap1-packs, not cleaned): Sanskrit and one Hindi pack against one English pack, at most 2,000 documents per pack, to measure each stage and extrapolate to all their documents (estimate_all_documents in h3_summary.json). Paths are relative to the era-v5-lab repository root: ../Cap1-packs holds <pack>/Part_N/ and <pack>/Heldout/, ../models/LaBSE the encoder in sentence-transformers format. Thresholds are the provisional defaults of h3.py.
